'''Geoffrey Horrocks''' (1932/33 [[Leicester]] – 12 September 2012) was a British mathematician working on [[vector bundle]]s, who introduced the [[Horrocks construction]] used in the [[ADHM construction]], and the [[Horrocks–Mumford bundle]] and [[Monad (homological algebra)|monads]].

He was a professor at [[Newcastle University]] until his retirement in 1998.
